gizmo.title: Rukunin Stop Note
gizmo.description: Tara stop notes da yawa cikin tubali ɗaya da ke nuna bayani ɗaya a lokaci guda, kamar Shawarwari ko Abin da ke sabo. Ana iya tara katunan umarni, bayanan gefe da ƙaulin mai firam tare da su.

configure.title: Lakabi
configure.description: Sunan rukunin da masu karanta allo ke sanarwa, kamar Shawarwari ko Abin da ke sabo.

configure.title: Bayanai
configure.description: Stop notes a cikin rukunin. Ana iya ƙara katunan umarni, bayanan gefe da ƙaulin mai firam ma.
